updates.title: CVE-2026-105590 Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A security feature bypass vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass certificate validation controls over the network. Organizations should apply the latest security updates to prevent potential unauthorized certificate issuance or relay attacks in Entra ID-integrated environments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148 Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability affects Active Directory Domain Services, the core identity service for Entra ID hybrid scenarios. Administrators managing on-premises AD environments should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082 Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos could disrupt authentication services that Entra ID and hybrid identity solutions depend upon. IT teams should review and apply available patches to maintain authentication continuity.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680 Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate identity requests in Entra ID-connected hybrid environments. Organizations relying on NTLM authentication should apply updates across affected Microsoft Office and Windows components.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Support for Legacy Office File Formats
updates.summary: Purview's server-side auto-labeling now extends to older Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling automatic sensitivity label enforcement across your entire document estate regardless of file age. Organizations can now ensure consistent information protection policies on legacy files without manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Administrators can now view detailed per-policy auto-labeling enforcement metrics showing which files have been labeled, remain unlabeled, and how enforcement compares to simulation snapshots. This transparency helps compliance teams track labeling progress and identify gaps in policy coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Enable Version Trimming for Retained Files in OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Administrators with appropriate Purview RBAC permissions can now trim retained file versions in OneDrive and SharePoint while maintaining compliance holds and legal obligations. This policy-scoped setting helps large enterprises reclaim storage consumed by version bloat without breaking retention promises.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Network Policies for All Websites via Entra GSA Integration
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies can now be scoped to all websites or all websites except specified cloud apps through Entra Global Secure Access integration, extending data protection to unsanctioned and unmanaged cloud applications. This broadens visibility and control over sensitive data flowing to websites outside the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Automated Deletion of Departed Employee Mailboxes and OneDrives
updates.summary: Administrators can now scale the deletion of both content and containers for departed users, automatically keeping tenant compliance without manual effort. This capability ensures timely offboarding and reduces the risk of orphaned user data exposure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Auto-Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit for E5-licensed customers, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth. This eliminates the risk of mailboxes becoming inoperative due to storage saturation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Premium Hold Reports for U.S. Government Clouds
updates.summary: Out-of-the-box hold reports for eDiscovery cases are now available in government cloud environments, allowing admins to view, sort, filter, and download aggregated legal hold information. This improves audit and compliance reporting capabilities for government agencies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector Moving to Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, improving security by requiring administrators to configure custom Entra app registrations with certificates. Organizations will use new PowerShell cmdlets to manage certificate import, configuration, and validation across workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Administrators can now include file archiving actions directly within Purview data retention policies for SharePoint, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends lifecycle management beyond keep-or-delete options to optimize storage costs without sacrificing governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) are now accessible via Microsoft Graph APIs, providing a unified view across physically distributed archive data as EWS APIs deprecate by October 2026. This modernizes programmatic access for archive management and reporting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now detects and can restrict sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, closing a gap in data exfiltration protection for file transfer methods. Administrators can configure these transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce consistent data protection across legacy file-transfer protocols.
